key_concepts: Female ovaries release one egg cell about every 28 days.
Fertilization in humans occurs in the fallopian tube or oviduct.
Male testes produce sperm, and the urethra carries urine and semen.
Menstruation is the monthly shedding of the endometrium when fertilization does not occur.
